claim: These are proposed typed service profiles, not standards definitions.

profiles.integration: integral of synchronized DC real power at the battery-side terminals
excluded_substitutions: state-of-charge estimate without a calibrated energy model
rectifier output when battery-side boundary is claimed

profiles.integration: integral of measured torque multiplied by angular velocity

profiles.useful_boundary: declared thermal control volume / process interface
profiles.integration: calibrated heat-flow integration or independently validated enthalpy change
excluded_substitutions: ambient temperature rise without a declared thermal model

profiles.useful_boundary: declared optical receiver plane or process aperture
profiles.integration: integral of calibrated radiant optical power across the declared aperture

profiles.useful_boundary: declared chemical process control volume and state boundary
profiles.integration: integrate the measured reaction chemical-potential change against reaction extent under the declared temperature, pressure and composition conditions
excluded_substitutions: nominal reaction yield without a state-function and uncertainty model
